hook: You don't have a reading problem. You have a keeping problem.
promise: Five keepable ideas from The Lean Startup: How Today’s Entrepreneurs Use Continuous Innovation to Create Radically Successful Businesses by Eric Ries — then a practice you can do tonight.

acts.name: The leak
beats: You don't have a reading problem. You have a keeping problem.
If you are thinking about becoming an entrepreneur, read this book
If you are just curious about entrepreneurship, read this book

acts.name: The practice
beats: Eric Ries’s revolutionary Lean Startup method will help bring your new business idea to an end result that is successful and sustainable
I particularly remember a moment from back then: the moment I realized my company was going to fail
We tried desperately to raise more capital, and we could not

acts.name: The shelf
beats: At the time, it had seemed we were doing everything right: we had a great product, a brilliant team, amazing technology, and the right idea at the right time
I think there is something deeply appealing about this modern-day rags-to-riches story
Don't just read. Build ideas. https://albuc.com
